CustomField.description: Odoo IB sub-task IDs for this order line (ns_sub_task_id - Installed Base service task). Populated by IP-2 new_service callback. Required by IP-4 change orders for delete/change/price_change line types. Typically same value as Odoo_Project_Task_IDs__c. Stored as comma-separated integer string.
CustomField.label: Odoo Sub Task IDs
